arb_recommendation: Approve Institutional Regime-Conditioned Feature Catalogue v1 for future hypothesis generation. Retain macro pressure, geo severity, and event counts as context variables, but do not promote them as standalone predictive features.

promoted_feature_registry.economic_rationale: Medium-horizon path dependence remains informative once the institutional regime is known.
promoted_feature_registry.summary: Cross-regime anchor summarizing medium-horizon gold context after conditioning on the six-state taxonomy.
promoted_feature_registry.title: 60-bar regime return anchor

promoted_feature_registry.economic_rationale: Twenty-bar return pressure captures the direction and exhaustion of the current gold move.
promoted_feature_registry.summary: Cross-regime return anchor identifying whether the current state is extended or resetting.
promoted_feature_registry.title: 20-bar XAU/USD return context

promoted_feature_registry.economic_rationale: Short downside stress continues to separate fragile rallies from durable ones.
promoted_feature_registry.summary: Drawdown and liquidation diagnostic that remains informative in bull, crisis, and compression states.
promoted_feature_registry.title: 20-bar breakdown persistence

promoted_feature_registry.economic_rationale: Expectation repricing is informative when macro states dominate cross-asset capital rotation.
promoted_feature_registry.summary: Expectation proxy used where USD and rate repricing matter more than pure gold momentum.
promoted_feature_registry.title: Forward expectation spread

promoted_feature_registry.economic_rationale: Risk transfer speed remains one of the few universally informative state variables.
promoted_feature_registry.summary: Volatility anchor preserved in every regime, even when its directional sign changes.
promoted_feature_registry.title: 20-bar regime volatility

promoted_feature_registry.economic_rationale: Long-horizon trend persistence matters most when a downside unwind must be distinguished from noise.
promoted_feature_registry.summary: Long/short trend separation approved primarily for unwind diagnostics.
promoted_feature_registry.title: 30/180 trend persistence gap

promoted_feature_registry.economic_rationale: Macro pressure only becomes economically useful once paired with the prevailing directional trend.
promoted_feature_registry.summary: Interaction term combining macro pressure with trend persistence to suppress misleading standalone macro signals.
promoted_feature_registry.title: Macro/trend interaction

promoted_feature_registry.economic_rationale: Breakout distance becomes critical only when crisis liquidity shocks stretch the tape.
promoted_feature_registry.summary: Crisis-state expansion feature used to distinguish continuation from dislocation exhaustion.
promoted_feature_registry.title: 60-bar breakout expansion

promoted_feature_registry.economic_rationale: Intermediate trend slope helps distinguish shock continuation from rapid mean reversion.
promoted_feature_registry.summary: Intermediate trend anchor promoted for crisis and unwind contexts with high path dependence.
promoted_feature_registry.title: 20/120 trend slope gap

promoted_feature_registry.economic_rationale: Immediate gold response is most informative when policy or event transitions reset positioning.
promoted_feature_registry.summary: Short-horizon reaction feature approved only for transition states.
promoted_feature_registry.title: 1-bar XAU/USD reaction

promoted_feature_registry.economic_rationale: Breakout information is only investable when aligned with a broader directional structure.
promoted_feature_registry.summary: Regime-specific interaction term that isolates event-driven continuation from ordinary trend following.
promoted_feature_registry.title: Trend/breakout interaction

promoted_feature_registry.economic_rationale: Event counts matter only when they amplify an already material macro-pressure shift.
promoted_feature_registry.summary: Sparse event-pressure interaction reserved for macro-transition campaigns.
promoted_feature_registry.title: Event pressure interaction

pruned_pairs.reason: Forward expectation retained the cross-asset information with clearer economic interpretation.
Longer regime return anchor dominated the overlapping medium-horizon trend signal.
Breakout expansion dominated short-horizon return echo during crisis states.
One-bar gold reaction subsumed standalone micro momentum during transitions.
Forward expectation captured the same cross-asset channel with cleaner semantics.

regime_feature_matrix.rationale: Persistent upside phases reward carry-aware pullback and expectation features.
Downside liquidation phases reward volatility control and trend persistence filters.
Compressed risk-premium phases reward slow-moving regime anchors over fast noise.
Shock states reward exhaustion and breakout diagnostics that separate panic from persistence.
Policy and event transitions reward short-horizon response features and event-conditioned trend interactions.
Sideways states reward context filters that suppress redundant trend and shock features.

rejected_feature_registry.rejection_reason: Retained as a regime-defining context variable, but rejected as a standalone predictive feature.
Too redundant with one-bar gold reaction during transitions and too weak elsewhere.
Rejected because its utility is absorbed by forward expectation once regime is conditioned.
Interaction complexity did not add enough stability over regime volatility and macro/trend interaction.
Sparse crisis-only coverage prevented institutional promotion.
Useful for taxonomy context, but too sparse and unstable as a direct predictive feature.
Rejected because the 20-bar return and breakout family dominated it across the approved states.

selected_methods.rationale: Captures nonlinear predictive information without introducing new model infrastructure.
Implemented by computing feature information only after conditioning on the accepted regime labels.
Approves only features whose sign and magnitude remain usable across temporal folds.
Rejects fragile features whose predictive direction flips under resampling.
Prevents the institutional catalogue from promoting near-duplicates.
Allows bounded deterministic interactions without expanding the frozen feature engine.
Would require introducing governed model-fitting infrastructure beyond the frozen stack.
Model-based attribution was intentionally excluded because Campaign 0003 is evidence curation, not model construction.
